assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.

Follow-up no-improvement review needs a documented current baseline encounter/window, completed PANSS baseline and follow-up per the S08 validated released definition, and adequate clozapine-trial context; improvement documents gate false not_applicable with no posterior claim, never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.
All 23 BN-07 distributions were missing and are synthetic uniform references here; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.
Whether review outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.
No percent-change cutoff, denominator or zero case is set here; the cutoff requires owner review. A missing PANSS follow-up is never treated as no improvement.
Outdated baselines pause for a fresh baseline choice with no recency threshold set here; not-assessed severity pauses and never coerces to No.
Trial-adequacy and observation-window operationalization, and monitoring/willingness input meanings, are open assumptions for owner review; no duration, dose or adherence thresholds are set here.
S08 PANSS is used without owner approval per the S08 exception; no owner-approval dependency is added for PANSS.

Two opposing projections of the same CPT yield identical posteriors, proving no clamping. This validates math and engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
